component.name: Col
component.summary: The island at the top of your screen
L’île en haut de votre écran

description.p: Col puts a small black island at the top of your screen. While you work, it shows what matters: the song playing, a coding agent waiting for you, the volume, a timer, your own scripts. Hover it or click it, and it opens.

ul.li: Now playing from any player that speaks MPRIS, with the cover, the controls and a scrubber
Synced lyrics from LRCLIB beside the player, the line being sung lit; click a line to jump there
Claude Code and Codex in the island, and their permission requests with Allow and Deny
A volume gauge, the battery and the charger
A timer that counts down in the island, keep awake and a clipboard history kept in memory
The colctl command and a local API to push your own live activities

description.p: This first Linux edition is a preview. It works best on desktops with the layer-shell protocol: KDE Plasma, COSMIC, Hyprland, Sway, niri and Wayfire. On GNOME the island runs under XWayland, below the top bar.
Col opens with a short intro: a line of light around the pill, the island swelling as its own chime rises, and waves spreading below it. Settings, Island turns it off or keeps it silent.
Released alongside Col 3.1 for the Mac. Nothing changes on Linux.
The first Linux edition of Col, a preview.
